title: Z.ai releases GLM-5.3-Flash, 320B open-weight multimodal model
summary: China's Z.ai released MIT-licensed GLM-5.3-Flash and confirmed it was behind the stealth 'Ox Alpha' model said to rival DeepSeek.

title: Nvidia posts record $96.2B quarterly revenue, up 106%
summary: Nvidia reported record quarterly revenue of $96.22 billion, more than doubling year on year on AI data-centre demand.

title: Altman says OpenAI is '80%' to AGI while delaying its biggest training run
summary: In a TIME interview, Sam Altman described an 'AI research intern' and said OpenAI is about 80% of the way to AGI, while holding its largest run until new safety controls are ready.
reason: Lab-leader claim about own progress; words, not verified.

title: Meta scrapped 'AI-native' plan that would have cut teams by 60%
summary: Ars Technica reported Meta's AI-native workforce push produced more code but more incidents, and Meta cancelled some planned cuts.
reason: Evidence AI substitution under-delivered; cuts cancelled.

title: Influence operations try to seed AI chatbots with propaganda
summary: The Guardian exposed a fake Israeli-funded thinktank publishing 124 reports in nine days to be cited by AI assistants; OpenAI also banned a Russian influence cluster.
reason: State-linked information manipulation via AI; attempt, limited reach.
